Path 2, trafficGOALS §3.4

AI gateway on Gateway API

One place in front of Claude and our MCP tools.

WHAT IT IS

A gateway that routes model and tool traffic with auth, per-team quota, cost attribution and audit. Envoy AI Gateway and kgateway build on Gateway API; vendor proxies offer the same as products.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Building on Gateway API makes it the same data plane as the ingress migration. Much of the ecosystem targets self-hosted models, which we don't need; the egress, quota and audit half is what we use.

WHERE WE STAND

One of the four components we build. Trial once the Gateway API migration has an owner.

"From Proxy to Platform: Building a Multi-Tenant AI Gateway" (Adobe), KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

AI gateway on Gateway API: One place in front of Claude and our MCP tools. Where we stand: One of the four components we build. Trial once the Gateway API migration has an owner. For us the gateway's job is egress to Claude and tool access, not load-balancing model servers.
